dargah_name: Dargah Hazrat Baba Sharfuddin Suhrwardi (Pahadi Shareef)
about: The resting place of Hazrat Baba Sharfuddin Suhrwardi, a Sufi saint of the Suhrawardi order. The shrine stands on a hillock at Pahadi Shareef, near RGI Airport, Hyderabad. || The annual Urs is held in the Islamic month of Shaban. Dates can shift with moon sighting, so check locally before travelling.
address: Pahadi Shareef, near RGI Airport, Hyderabad
source: Siasat news report on the 759th Urs; Wikipedia: Pahari Sharif

dargah_name: Moula Ali Dargah
about: A hilltop shrine at Moula Ali, known as Koh-e-Moula Ali, associated with Hazrat Ali. || Each year people gather here in Rajab for the Urs, with processions and offerings. Dates can shift with moon sighting, so check locally.
source: Deccan Chronicle report on Moula Ali Urs (2018)

dargah_name: Dargah Yousufain (Yousufain and Shareefain)
tagline: Tomb of the saints Yousufain and Shareefain, Nampally
about: The tomb of the Sufi saints Syed Shah Yousufuddin and Syed Shah Sharifuddin, known together as Yousufain or Shareefain, in Nampally. || The Urdu poet Daagh Dehlvi is also buried here.
source: Wikipedia: Dargah Yousufain

dargah_name: Dargah Hazrat Shah Khamosh
tagline: Shrine of a saint from Bidar, Nampally
about: Shrine in Nampally of a saint from Bidar who is remembered for keeping silent for 25 years.
source: Deccan Chronicle: Nampally Sufi heritage

dargah_name: Dargah Aghapura
tagline: Shrine of Shah Mohammed Hassan Abul Ulai
about: The burial place of Shah Mohammed Hassan Abul Ulai. The Urs here includes qawwali, recitation of Sufi poetry.
source: Deccan Chronicle: Nampally Sufi heritage

dargah_name: Dargah Hussain Shah Wali
about: A mausoleum and shrine built in honour of the Sufi saint Hussain Shah Wali by Abdullah Qutb Shah, at Shaikpet near Golconda.
source: Wikipedia: Hussain Shah Wali

dargah_name: Dargah Jahangir Peer
tagline: Shrine at Anmul Narva village near Hyderabad
about: A well-known dargah at Anmul Narva village in Kothur mandal, Ranga Reddy district. The annual Urs was reported for January in 2026; exact dates are not listed here yet.
address: Anmul Narva, Kothur mandal, Ranga Reddy district
source: Siasat news report, January 2026
